dataset: AOT proof-of-concept AO telemetry / ESO CIAO1

processing.selection: Every 50th released loop frame; numeric streams otherwise unmodified except JSON rounding to six decimal places.
processing.measurements: GRADIENTS contains released Shack-Hartmann slope measurements; INTENSITIES contains released subaperture intensity values; HODM POSITIONS contains recorded deformable-mirror commands.
processing.limits: No phase-map or PSF reconstruction is inferred from these streams in the observation view.
